nodes_source.source_quote: The data used to support the results of this study are available from the corresponding author upon request.
nodes_source.description: Empirical traffic data and video frames from 7:50 a.m. to 9:00 a.m. on the freeway connecting Qingdao and Huangdao, used to calibrate the SUMO simulation.
nodes_source.reproducibility_rationale: Data availability statement explicitly notes access is upon request from the corresponding author.

nodes_process.source_quote: The proposed method is evaluated in SUMO, an open-source microscopic traffic simulator [31].
nodes_process.description: Set up the simulated road network covering the on-ramp, upstream and downstream mainlines, and merging area, calibrated with empirical data.
nodes_process.reproducibility_rationale: clarity=3, simulator named, basic speed limits stated, but detailed car-following parameters omitted.

nodes_process.source_quote: Three consecutive frames of the traffic video in the controlled area are needed as the observation input... After zooming and down-sampling, the size of one observation is 4 × 512 in pixels.
nodes_process.description: Extract vehicle locations from raw images to reconstruct visual representations. Down-sample and stack matrices of 3 consecutive time steps to represent the traffic state.
nodes_process.reproducibility_rationale: clarity=3, no specific image processing library named, but operations and dimensions are clearly stated.

nodes_process.source_quote: The Q-network is trained in 10^6 training frames... The gradient-based algorithm Adam [28] is used to update w_i to minimize the loss function.
nodes_process.description: Train the DRL agent using Q-learning with experience replay and a target network. A multitask learning strategy predicts mean speed and queue length simultaneously.
nodes_process.reproducibility_rationale: clarity=4, optimizer named, all key hyperparameters provided in Table 1.

nodes_process.source_quote: each scenario is evaluated in 20 simulation experiments... For comparative purposes, two scenarios are also considered... no control... and the PI-ALINEA method.
nodes_process.description: Evaluate the trained DRL policy against no-control and PI-ALINEA baselines across 20 simulation experiments with different random seeds.
nodes_process.reproducibility_rationale: clarity=4, simulator named, baseline parameters and number of runs explicitly stated.

nodes_process.source_quote: A perturbation analysis is conducted to evaluate the impact of information contained in video data... the control area is divided into eight subareas.
nodes_process.description: Remove information from different subareas of the original data to generate perturbed data and evaluate the impact on travel time.
nodes_process.reproducibility_rationale: clarity=3, procedure described and parameters stated, though specific masking implementation details are omitted.

nodes_sink.source_quote: The training process, presented in Figure 8, can be finished in less than 24 hours on a computing server
nodes_sink.description: Convergence curves showing episode reward and mean travel time over 1 million training frames.
nodes_sink.reproducibility_rationale: Simulator and hyperparameters are stated, but exact training scripts and empirical data used for SUMO calibration are available only upon request.

nodes_sink.source_quote: Figure 9 presents the Q1 (25%), Q2 (50%), and Q3 (75%) of the travel times in the mainline for three scenarios.
nodes_sink.description: Vehicle travel times in the mainline over time (8:00-9:00) for no control, PI-ALINEA, and Deep RL scenarios.
nodes_sink.reproducibility_rationale: Simulation setup and methods are described, but the specific empirical dataset and code to reproduce the exact curves are not public.

nodes_sink.source_quote: Table 2 presents mean vehicle travel times in 20 simulation experiments.
nodes_sink.description: Mean travel times across 20 simulation experiments for No controls, PI-ALINEA, and DRL scenarios, including percentage differences.
nodes_sink.reproducibility_rationale: Results are clearly aggregated from 20 simulation runs, but exact random seeds, empirical data, and code are not open.

nodes_sink.source_quote: Figure 10 presents the temporal-spatial distribution of the mean speeds along the mainline.
nodes_sink.description: Temporal-spatial heatmaps of mean speeds in the mainline for no-control, PI-ALINEA, and DRL scenarios.
nodes_sink.reproducibility_rationale: Clear visualization of simulation outputs, but relies on unavailable SUMO calibration data and code.

nodes_sink.source_quote: Figure 11 presents the Q1, Q2, and Q3 of the queue lengths at the on-ramp in three scenarios.
nodes_sink.description: Queue length at the on-ramp over time for no control, PI-ALINEA, and Deep RL scenarios.
nodes_sink.reproducibility_rationale: Clear aggregation of simulation outputs, but relies on unavailable SUMO calibration data and code.

nodes_sink.source_quote: Figure 12 presents the mean queue lengths at the on-ramp and the red ratios (i.e., the proportion of the red phase in the simulation time) in each simulation
nodes_sink.description: Scatter plots showing the relationship between queue length and red ratio for PI-ALINEA and DRL.
nodes_sink.reproducibility_rationale: Clear aggregation of simulation outputs, but relies on unavailable SUMO calibration data and code.

nodes_sink.source_quote: Figure 13 presents the queue lengths at the on-ramp and the occupancy downstream of the merging area for the two ramp metering methods.
nodes_sink.description: Time series comparing queue length and downstream occupancy for PI-ALINEA and DRL.
nodes_sink.reproducibility_rationale: Clear aggregation of simulation outputs, but relies on unavailable SUMO calibration data and code.

nodes_sink.source_quote: The better performance of the proposed DRL method is further revealed when considering traffic flows downstream of the merge area, which is demonstrated in Figure 14.
nodes_sink.description: Box plots of downstream traffic volume over time for no control, PI-ALINEA, and Deep RL scenarios.
nodes_sink.reproducibility_rationale: Clear aggregation of simulation outputs, but relies on unavailable SUMO calibration data and code.

nodes_sink.source_quote: Figure 16 presents the box plot of travel time when the information of different subareas is removed, and the baseline is the result of experiments that take original data as input.
nodes_sink.description: Box plots of travel time with perturbed input data, comparing a baseline against scenarios where information from specific subareas is removed.
nodes_sink.reproducibility_rationale: Clear aggregation of simulation outputs, but relies on unavailable SUMO calibration data and code.
